S&P upgrades Canadian Pacific Kansas City to A- on cross-border growth momentum
summary: Investing.com -- S&P Global Ratings upgraded Canadian Pacific Kansas City Limited (NYSE:CP) to A- from BBB+ on Tuesday, citing sustained operational outperformance and expanded growth opportunities following its acquisition of Kansas City Southern. The agency assigned a stable outlook to the freight railroad operator and raised its issue-level rating on the company's unsecured debt to A- from BBB+.
